title: Align hitboxes and loading feedback for icon and compact buttons
creator: Ava Mitchell
description: Problem: Several regressions and inconsistent behaviors have been reported for compact and icon-only button variants: touch hitboxes smaller than recommended, inconsistent loading spinner alignment and opacity across themes, and a focus-ring flicker when toggling disabled/loading states. This ticket standardizes hitbox sizing, unifies loading affordances, and adds regression tests and implementation guidance for engineering.
acceptance_criteria: All button variants (default, compact, icon-only) must meet a 40x40px accessible touch target when rendered at small sizes via token-driven padding or hitbox overlay
Loading state shows a centered spinner with consistent size and opacity across themes; label should visually hide without changing layout (no layout shift)
Disabled + loading transitions do not trigger double focus outlines or flicker; keyboard navigation remains predictable
Design tokens introduced for hitbox, spinner-size, spinner-opacity, and compact-padding with token names documented in the tokens guide
Playwright visual regression tests added and green for Chrome/Firefox on Linux and Mac; Percy snapshots show no regressions vs baseline
Engineering implementation PR includes a short migration note for internal components that relied on previous 32px hitbox assumption
comments: 2025-02-11 - Ava Mitchell: Raised initial issue after QA flagged inconsistent spinner opacity in dark theme and touch targets measured <40px on mobile. Created exploratory frames in Figma comparing current vs proposed tokens.

2025-02-13 - Diego Rios: Did a quick audit of CSS — some components used .btn-padding-small (32px total) vs new guidance. Propose introducing a hitbox overlay token (--rwd-hitbox-min) to avoid breaking layout.
2025-02-18 - PM: Leah Carter: Customer reported keyboard focus flicker during A/B rollout of new button styles; this should be prioritized for the next patch release. Marking P1.

2025-02-20 - Ava Mitchell: Design decision: keep visible size of compact icon buttons at 32px but add invisible 40px hitbox via :before pseudo-element; pros: zero layout churn, consistent touch target. Con: slightly more complex CSS and z-index considerations. Documented pattern in Confluence.

2025-02-24 - Diego Rios: Engineering note: implementing pseudo-element overlay breaks in nested overflow:auto containers — fallback plan is an aria-hidden span wrapper when overlay can't escape clipping. Filed ENG-1502 to track wrapper approach.

2025-02-25 - Design review (summary): Reviewed spinner scale options (12px vs 14px). Consensus: 12px in compact/icon-only, 14px in default; spinner-opacity token set to 0.85 in light theme and 0.65 in dark to improve perceived contrast. Action: update tokens file and handoff.

2025-02-28 - QA: Ran early Playwright snapshots, observed focus-ring flicker remains when toggling disabled -> loading state quickly. Root cause: double focus outline from focus-visible polyfill and native outline. Proposed fix: remove polyfill for button components and rely on system focus-visible. Filed ENG-1459 as dependency.

2025-03-02 - Diego Rios: Implementation PR opened; includes CSS token variables, pseudo-element hitbox, spinner component update, and migration note. Need accessibility review and cross-browser testing. @Ava please sanity-check visual diffs in PR.

2025-03-03 - Ava Mitchell: Reviewed PR; requested small spacing tweak for RTL when icon is trailing (padding swap). Also requested that spinner uses prefers-reduced-motion to disable rotation for users who opt out. Marked ticket In Progress and added acceptance criteria for reduced-motion behavior.
